Themes & Desktop tutorial

omarchy-settings on Omarchy

The default look, fonts, and boot theme Omarchy ships with, in one system package.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install omarchy-settings on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings. It is a 732 KB download (1.3 MB installed), version 4.0.5-1, licensed MIT. Omarchy user defaults, /etc/skel content, fonts, plymouth theme, and support helpers. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install omarchy-settings on Omarchy

Omarchy-settings installs the baseline configuration for the Omarchy Linux distribution: the files that get copied into every new user's home directory (/etc/skel), the default font set, the Plymouth boot-splash theme, and small helper scripts the rest of the system relies on. It is not an app you open; it is the plumbing that makes a freshly installed Omarchy desktop look and behave consistently out of the box.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 4.0.5-1:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-settings

Open and use omarchy-settings

omarchy-settings has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql omarchy-settings | grep /usr/bin/

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-settings on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-settings. The download is 732 KB and it takes 1.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-settings free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-settings?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-settings. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-settings depend on?

The package declares 5 dependencies: bash, curl, gum, hicolor-icon-theme, plymouth. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-settings a desktop app?

No. omarchy-settings has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is omarchy-settings in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-settings (version 4.0.5-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. 37signals makes it. Project site: https://github.com/basecamp/omarchy. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
